12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

1275-accept.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-accept.text:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, $N.
1275-accept.title: Researching the Corruption

248-accept.name: Unknown
248-accept.text:
I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep.  I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.

Take another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.

Find a suitable object on which to place the Glyph.  A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
248-accept.title: Looking Further

274-complete.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
274-complete.text: A disarming colloid? For Seaforium?  Oh heavens!
274-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

274-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
274-progress.text: What is that you bring from Ashlan?
274-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

278-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
278-accept.text:
Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, $N.  Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan.  Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well.  But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure.  The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.

We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack!  Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
278-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

3765-accept.name: Argos Nightwhisper
3765-accept.text:
Stormwind -- such a bustling hub of activity.

I have traveled from afar to seek help. Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.

My brother, Gershala, requires assistance in Darkshore. He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.

The journey is a long and epic one. It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned $c such as yourself.
3765-accept.title: The Corruption Abroad

3765-complete.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
3765-complete.text: Ah, so my brother, Argos, sent you? I realize you must be weary from your travels. But we have much to talk about.
3765-complete.title: The Corruption Abroad

466-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
466-accept.text:
I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate.  Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining.  If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
466-accept.title: Search for Incendicite

467-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
467-complete.text: Hello $N.  You're here about the task I have, eh?  It's good to see a young $r like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
467-complete.title: Stonegear's Search

94-complete.name: Unknown
94-complete.text:
You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone.  It adheres itself ... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:

You have my gratitude, young $N.  You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you ... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
94-complete.title: A Watchful Eye

94-progress.name: Unknown
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye

94499-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-complete.text:
Aye, this is good water, $N. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed prove you're ready for the next stage of your journey.

One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
94499-complete.title: Call of Water

94499-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-progress.text: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
94499-progress.title: Call of Water

94500-accept.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-accept.text:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500-accept.title: Call of Water
